definitions.explanation: Hardened plaque that builds up on the teeth and has to be removed by a dentist or hygienist.

examples.japanese: {歯石|しせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the tartar removed from my teeth.

examples.japanese: {歯石|しせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}→歯周病：28680_shishuubyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When tartar builds up, you are more prone to gum disease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歯石|しせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除去|じょきょ}して→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make a point of having my teeth scaled at the dentist once every six months.

notes:
Not to be confused with its homophone ⟦{史跡|しせき}→史跡：11952_shiseki⟧ (historic site).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯石|しせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove tartar
- {歯石|しせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる / つく: tartar builds up
- {歯石|しせき}⟦{除去|じょきょ}→除去：14567_jokyo⟧: scaling, tartar removal

RELATED WORDS:
- {歯垢|しこう}: plaque (soft, before it hardens)
- ⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧: cavity
